free_tier.stated: no free allowance inside the paid tier: Individual is USD 20 a month as Megawatt (USD 20 of agent usage and 750 hours, 45,000 minutes, of a1.small Amp-hosted orbs) or USD 200 a month as Gigawatt (USD 200 of agent usage and 1,000 hours of a1.xxlarge orbs); Megawatt is USD 10 a month with the education discount
free_tier.notes: the free offer is Hobby (coding-subs/amp-hobby); the included allowances reset each monthly billing period and do not roll over

interface_detail: the `amp` CLI. Headless: `amp -x "prompt"` (execute mode) sends the prompt, waits for the agent's turn to end, prints the final message and exits; `amp -ox` is shorthand for `--orb-execute -x` and starts the same prompt in an Amp-hosted orb that spends the tier's orb minutes, prints the thread URL and exits; `--orb-size` picks the orb size and `--stream-json` streams events; scripts and CI set AMP_API_KEY to an access token from Settings that starts with `sgamp_`; the web app and the macOS, iOS and Android apps run the same threads
tooling: the amp CLI (macOS, Linux, or Windows through WSL), the web app at ampcode.com, and the macOS, iOS and Android apps; the agent runs in an Amp-hosted orb, locally, or on one of the user's own runners
chaining: Megawatt at USD 20 a month bundles USD 20 of Amp-served agent usage and 45,000 orb minutes, so a headless `amp -ox` job runs on the vendor's machines with no machine of the user's own; the free Hobby tier (coding-subs/amp-hobby) takes the same agent with a linked ChatGPT or Claude subscription or own keys, and any key in inference/ works instead of Amp-served usage

limits.value: Megawatt: 750 hours (45,000 minutes) of a1.small Amp-hosted orbs a month; larger orbs use the hours faster; included usage resets each monthly billing period and does not roll over
Megawatt: USD 20 of agent usage a month for Amp-served models and tools, then credits at list price; Gigawatt: USD 200 of agent usage and 1,000 hours of a1.xxlarge orbs a month
Amp repository hosting soft limits: Megawatt 1 GB of storage and 10 GB of data transfer; Gigawatt 10 GB and 100 GB
orb spawn pacing: a burst of 20 metered orbs per user, then one new orb every five minutes; later orb starts wait instead of failing

limits_note: the a1.3xlarge orb (16 CPUs, 44 GB) is available only to Gigawatt subscribers and Enterprise workspace members; purchased credits expire twelve months after purchase; the Teams card has no extra charge and each member keeps their own tier, with included orb time per person
binding_note: the monthly orb-time and agent-usage allowances are the first thing a heavy headless user exhausts; past them, credits at list price keep the work going

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up page offers an email address ('Continue with Email') or 'Sign in with ChatGPT'; the payment method the paid tier takes is unverified: behind a sign-up (the pricing page states only that invoices are issued through Stripe)

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; an orb pauses 5 minutes after the agent finishes or 20 minutes after the last interaction, whichever comes later, and a paused orb is not billed
confidence_note: prices and allowances are quoted from the vendor's pricing documentation and pricing page read on 2026-11-02; the Gigawatt sub-tier is shown on the pricing page only behind a client-rendered tab, so its price and allowance rest on the markdown source of the documentation page. The payment method and the live checkout are unverified: behind a sign-up.
